View our Youtube View our portfolio on Twitter Our Customization Process Step   0:Use the price calculator to get an initial estimate and save on your budget Price Guide MidDream Kigu 3.0 Starts from $540 USD before optional design add-ons and international delivery.
      Add-ons require a manual quote because every custom design has different complexity. Base Package $540 Includes the base mask commission and studio tax / processing fee. Design Add-ons Manual Quote Custom accessories and special structures are quoted after design review. Sharing Discount -$80 Available for customers who share photos and shopping experience within 3 months. Delivery Service By Area Shipping and import-related costs depend on destination and delivery method. Base Package The base package starts from $540 USD. The two items below explain how the base package price is made.
          They are included in the base package and are not optional add-on charges. Base Mask Commission MidDream Kigu 3.0 base mask commission fee converted from MidDream Studio’s Mainland China pricing. $450 USD Studio Tax & Processing Fee Mainland China tax, payment processing, order handling, and preparation fee.
            Calculated as 20% of the base mask commission fee. $90 USD Design Add-ons Please select whether the design includes extra add-ons. Add-ons are not automatically priced by this calculator.
          They require a manual quote after reviewing the customer’s design reference. No extra design add-ons Select this if the design does not include extra accessories, special structures, or complex custom details.
              The add-on amount will be shown as $0 USD. Has extra design add-ons Select this if the design includes head accessories, horns, glasses, special markings, complex decorations,
              or special structures. The add-on price will be confirmed through a second-step manual quote. Community Sharing Discount Customers who are willing to send photos after receiving the order and share their shopping experience
          on social media within 3 months may receive an $80 USD discount. No, I do not want to use this discount Select this if you do not plan to send photos or share your shopping experience on social media.
              No discount will be applied. Yes, I agree to send photos and share my shopping experience I agree to send photos within 3 months after receiving the order and share my shopping experience
              on social media. An $80 USD discount will be applied to this estimate. Destination Select the customer destination to estimate international delivery and import-related service costs. European Union / EU / United Kingdom / UK EU and UK use the same pricing standard. MidDream-handled delivery uses air shipping. Australia / AU Australia uses air shipping. Estimated air shipping is around $50 USD higher than the EU / UK standard. United States / US US customers can choose sea shipping as the default lower-cost option. Air shipping is available as a paid upgrade. Delivery & Import Service Choose whether MidDream handles delivery and import-related service estimates, or whether the customer handles them independently. MidDream-Handled Delivery Service EU / UK air shipping estimate: $220–$260. Import Tax & Customs Deposit estimate: $100–$220.
              Recommended for first-time buyers and customers who prefer a simpler process. Customer-Handled Shipping & Import Recommended for experienced customers who are familiar with forwarding services.
              MidDream will charge only the base package and any manually quoted add-ons. US Shipping Method This section applies only when the destination is United States and delivery is handled by MidDream. US Sea Shipping Lower-cost default option. Sea shipping fee: $120 USD for a 45×45×45cm package. US Air Shipping Upgrade Faster shipping option available at an additional quoted fee. Enter the quoted air shipping amount below. $ Calculate Estimated Total Estimated Price Breakdown Step   1:Discuss the technical details with us and get a character quote Step 1 · Character Quote Discuss the technical details with us. Send us your character references and commission requirements through Discord.
      We will review the design complexity, confirm the technical details, and provide a personalized quote for your kigu mask commission. Prepare References Character images Front view, side view, hairstyle, eye design, skin tone, outfit references, and any expression details you want us to match. Confirm Complexity Technical review We will check the mask structure, wig styling, accessories, color details, and any special parts before giving a quote. Get Your Quote Personalized price Since every character is different, the final quote depends on modeling difficulty, painting details, wig work, and add-ons. Ready to start your commission? Message us on Discord with your character name, reference images, preferred mask version, destination country, and any special requirements.
        Our team will help you confirm whether the design is suitable for Kiglover 3.0 or Kiglover Lite. Get Quote on Discord Follow Us on X Read Commission Guide Tip: Clear references help us quote faster. Please include character images, hairstyle details, eye style,
      accessories, skin tone, and whether you need extra props or special structures. Step   2:Custom-modeled for your character Step 2 · Modeling Custom-modeled for your character. Each kigu mask is modeled according to the customer’s character references and design requirements.
      We do not simply reuse one standard model for every order. Before painting, wig styling, and final assembly,
      we create a base model preview so you can check the overall shape, facial proportions, expression, and key structural details at an early stage. Example modeling preview: this image is used to show what the base model review stage looks like.
          Actual previews vary by character and commission. Custom Modeling Built for your character We create the base model according to your character’s face shape, eye placement, mouth design, side profile,
            and overall silhouette. Each model is made for the specific character, not copied from a single shared template. Customer Review You check the details At this step, you can review whether the model captures the feeling of your character and point out anything that needs adjustment. Revision Stage Changes are welcome here This is the ideal time to request changes to the shape, expression, proportions, and visible structure before the model is finalized. Key Advantage Custom-modeled for your character, then revised until you are satisfied. Every character has different facial features, proportions, expression, and overall feeling.
        That is why we create a dedicated base model for each customer’s character instead of using the same model for every order.
        After the modeling preview is sent, you can request modifications until you are happy with the result. Why this matters: a custom-modeled base helps the final mask look closer to your character’s actual design.
      Since major structural changes become much harder after painting, wig styling, and assembly begin, we confirm the base model with you first. Step 3:Printing & Sanding Step 3 · Printing & Sanding Printed with high-quality resin. Once the custom base model is confirmed, we move it into the physical production stage.
      For Kiglover 3.0 kigurumi masks, our standard production uses high-quality light-cured resin printing.
      We do not use PLA, PETG, or other FDM-style printing methods for Kiglover 3.0 masks unless specifically requested by the customer. Approved Model Printed after confirmation Printing begins only after the base model has been reviewed and approved.
          This helps make sure the physical mask follows the confirmed character shape before production continues. Resin Printing High-quality light-cured resin Kiglover 3.0 masks are printed using high-quality light-cured resin as our standard method.
          This allows us to create a cleaner and more refined base shell for later surface finishing. Hand Sanding Surface preparation by hand After printing, we carefully sand the surface by hand to refine edges, smooth the shell,
          and prepare a better base for painting and final finishing. Key Material Advantage Kiglover 3.0 uses resin printing as the standard. For Kiglover 3.0 kigurumi masks, we use high-quality light-cured resin printing instead of PLA, PETG,
        or other common FDM-style printing methods. Resin printing helps create a more refined base for the mask.
        After printing, we hand-sand the shell to improve the surface before painting. Why this matters: material choice and surface preparation directly affect the final finish.
      A high-quality resin-printed base, combined with careful hand sanding, helps the later painting, detailing,
      and final presentation look cleaner and more polished. Step 4:Kigu Mask Art Step 4 · Kigu Mask Art Bringing the character’s face to life. After the printed base has been sanded and prepared, we begin the kigu mask art stage.
      This is where the character’s facial details, colors, expression, and overall visual style are carefully painted onto the mask.
      For Kiglover 3.0, the mask art is customized for the character rather than using one fixed standard look. Custom Mask Art Painted for the character The face is painted according to the character reference, including skin tone, blush, mouth details, facial shadows,
          expression, and other visible character features. Progress Checkpoint Painting progress is shared During this checkpoint, we share kigu mask art progress with the customer.
          You can request adjustments related to the current painting stage within technical boundaries. Paint & Protection Model paints and protective finish We use model paints such as Mr. Hobby or other suitable model paints for the painting process,
          and protective paints such as Tamiya or other model paints for the finishing layer. Key Checkpoint You can review the mask art before we move forward. The kigu mask art stage is one of the key production checkpoints.
        This is the best time to check color balance, facial expression, blush, mouth details,
        eye-area style, and other painted character features. Revision requests should focus on this stage
        and remain technically possible for the current production progress. Why this matters: mask art is what turns the prepared shell into a recognizable character face.
      Careful color matching, facial detailing, and protective finishing help the final mask look closer to the original character design. Step 5:Choose wig structure Step 5 · Wig Structure & Styling Several wig structures are available. Different characters may require different wig structures depending on hairstyle, wearing habits,
      and maintenance preferences. Kiglover supports several common kigu mask wig structures, including
      full detachable wigs, non-detachable wigs, and detachable bangs wigs. Full Detachable Wig For hairstyle changes A full detachable wig is suitable for characters with multiple hairstyles or for situations where
          the entire wig may need to be removed or replaced in the future. This structure gives more flexibility,
          but it usually requires more maintenance and can be harder to wear alone. Non-Detachable Wig Fixed and easier to maintain A non-detachable wig is fixed onto the kigu mask. It is generally easier to wear by yourself,
          requires less frequent maintenance, and helps keep the hairstyle stable.
          However, it cannot be fully removed or replaced like a detachable wig. Detachable Bangs Wig Removable front bangs A detachable bangs wig keeps the back part of the wig fixed while allowing the bangs section to be removed.
          This structure can be useful when the front hairstyle needs extra flexibility while the back of the wig remains stable. Wig Structure Options The wig structure is selected according to the character and usage needs. Some characters may need a fully detachable wig for hairstyle changes, while others may be better suited
        to a fixed wig structure for easier wearing and maintenance. Detachable bangs can also be used when the front
        hairstyle needs extra flexibility while keeping the back part stable. Wig structure reference You can read our wig structure guide for a more detailed explanation of the differences between common
        kigu mask wig structures. Read Wig Structure Guide Step 6:Wig Styling & Customer Confirmation Step 6 · Wig Styling & Customer Confirmation Styling the wig to match the character. After the wig structure has been confirmed, we move into the wig styling stage.
      The wig is trimmed, shaped, and adjusted according to the character’s hairstyle, including bangs, side hair,
      length, volume, silhouette, and other visible hair details. Character Hairstyle Styled according to references We style the wig based on the character references, paying attention to the overall shape, front bangs,
          side hair, back silhouette, color impression, and recognizable hairstyle features. Styling Process Trimmed and shaped by hand The wig is adjusted by hand to better fit the mask and the selected wig structure.
          Depending on the design, this may include trimming, shaping, layering, hardening, or special styling work. Customer Confirmation Progress is shared for review After the main styling work is completed, we share the wig progress with the customer.
          You can review the hairstyle and request adjustments related to the current wig styling stage. Confirmation Checkpoint You can review the wig styling before final assembly. This checkpoint allows the customer to check whether the hairstyle matches the character’s feeling.
        Feedback can focus on styling details such as bangs, hair volume, side shape, visible length,
        silhouette, and other wig-related details that can still be adjusted at this stage. Note: revision requests at this stage should focus on the wig styling itself.
      Changes to the previously confirmed wig structure may be difficult once styling and assembly have already started. Step 7:Final Photos & Shipping Step 7 · Final Photos & Shipping Final photos before shipping. After the mask, wig, and final details are completed, we take finished photos for the customer to review.
      Once the final confirmation is completed, we record the packing process, carefully pack the mask, and prepare it for shipment. Final Photos Finished look is shared We take photos of the completed kigu mask so the customer can review the final appearance,
          including the face, wig, overall styling, and visible finished details. Customer Confirmation Final check before packing The final photos are used as the last confirmation checkpoint before shipment.
          This helps make sure the completed mask has been reviewed before it is packed. X Photo Sharing Please tell us if you prefer privacy We may share photos of the completed work on X: @kiglover_site .
          If you do not want us to post photos of your commission, please let us know at this step. Packing Video Packing process is recorded Before shipping, we provide a packing video to show how the completed mask is protected and placed into the package.
          This helps document the condition of the mask before it leaves our studio. Packing & Shipping Carefully packed for delivery After confirmation and packing video recording, the mask is packed carefully to protect the face, wig,
          and finished parts during transportation. Shipping is then arranged according to the order details and destination. Packing video example This video shows an example of the packing process. For commissioned orders, we provide a packing video before shipment so the customer can see how the finished mask is protected. Final Checkpoint Photos and packing video are provided before shipment. This final step gives the customer a clear look at the finished commission before shipping.
        The final photos document the completed mask condition and styling result, while the packing video shows how the mask is protected before dispatch.
        If the customer does not want the finished work to be shared on X, they should tell us during this final confirmation step. Shipping note: after the package is shipped, we recommend recording an unboxing video when receiving the parcel.
      This helps document the package condition and the mask condition at the time of delivery.
